harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a four-node distributed MinIO cluster on the 10.100.110.0/24 storage network with authenticated TLS S3 on port 9000. The infra-data bucket contains proof.txt with the required content. One-member availability, automatic rejoin/healing, post-restart writes, and sequential restart persistence across all four nodes were verified.
actions_performed: Installed MinIO on node1-node4 and MinIO Client administration on node1.
Configured private-CA TLS, protected shared credentials, EC:2 storage, automatic service restart, and dedicated-network bindings.
Stopped node4 and proved reads and writes continued with three members.
Restored node4 and proved full membership, endpoint reads, and healing of the outage-written shard.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 individually, verifying changed boot IDs and full recovery after each.
Verified final 4/4 health, anonymous access denial, required object persistence, and a post-restart write/read.

evidence.requirement: Distributed MinIO topology and authenticated TLS S3 on port 9000
evidence.summary: All services use the four HTTPS 10.100.110.x:9000 storage endpoints. Authenticated reads succeeded through every member, anonymous access returned 403, and EC:2 reported four online drives.

evidence.requirement: node1 MinIO Client administration, infra-data bucket, and required proof.txt
evidence.summary: node1 created the bucket and object, read distributed-storage-ready, and verified the same object after all restarts.

evidence.requirement: Read/write availability with one storage member unavailable
evidence.summary: node4 was inactive with port 9000 closed; the remaining 3/4 cluster read proof.txt and wrote/read member-outage-proof.txt while retaining HTTP 200 cluster health.

evidence.requirement: Automatic member rejoin and current-data healing
evidence.summary: The outage-written shard was absent on stopped node4. After normal service start, node4 rejoined 4/4, served current objects through its endpoint, and acquired the healed local shard.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, active TLS service, 4/4 membership, persistent shards, and object reads.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, local service/data recovery, 4/4 membership, and endpoint-specific reads.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, local service/data recovery, 4/4 membership, and endpoint-specific reads.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, local service/data recovery, 4/4 membership, and endpoint-specific reads.

evidence.requirement: Final recovered state on every node
evidence.summary: After all restarts, every node has active/enabled MinIO, verified TLS health, port 9000 listening, and local shards for all test objects; the cluster is 4/4 EC:2 and accepts new writes.
